text:
laura: I opened a small PR with 'lite-schema' examples for tool calls + a compact SDK snippet: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1407. Can folks skim for correctness and broken links?
ci-bot: preview build passed :white_check_mark: https://deploy.preview/redwood/docs/pr-1407
alex: Quick skim: your SDK sample references `resp.output_schema` but the client uses `resp.schema` publicly. Recommend switching to `resp.schema`.
laura: Good catch 1 Will change. Also added a short "migration tradeoffs" blurb but kept it terse.
sameer: For nullable arrays, prefer explicit anyOf on items instead of type arrays. Example: `{\"type\":\"array\",\"items\":{\"anyOf\":[{\"type\":\"object\"},{\"type\":\"null\"}]}}`. Runtime and downstream parsers behave more predictably with that form.
maria: UX note: include one-line streaming fallback in the SDK snippet so users don't assume non-streaming only. Tiny suggestion: `if (res.stream) for await (const c of res.stream) handle(c);`
laura: Thanks all. I'll push the client property rename, the nullable-array example, and the streaming line. Any stale links I should watch for?
alex: One reference points to /docs/function-calls; canonical route is /docs/tool-calling. Also a filename mismatch in examples/invoke-compact.md vs invoke-compact-example.md.
laura: Will fix both. If there are no other blockers I'll merge after CI stays green.
ci-bot: merge queued by laura :rocket:
